title: Type definitions (data/defs.json)
description: Object types with their defaults, enemy types, spells, and the look and rules of the special static block types.

spells.description: Spell tuning, by spell id. What each spell does is built into the engine (SPELL_EFFECTS in src/game.js; Zap: src/entities/bolt.js, Shield: Player.raiseShield()).

zap.description: A fast bolt the way the wizard faces; it stops at blocks and objects and hits the first enemy in its way.

speed.description: Bolt speed in units per second.

damage.description: Integrity an enemy loses per hit.

shield.description: A crackling ring of electricity round the wizard for a while (D73); it will block projectiles once there are any.

duration.description: Seconds the shield stays up; casting it again starts it over.

pickups.description: Pickup types (D71), by id. Permanent ones (data disks) set a save bit and stay found; temporary ones (refills) come back with the room.

blocks.description: Block types (D60), by id; room blocks name one in "type" (default "block"). The engine only knows properties (damage, lethal) and looks; a new type that combines them is data only. Rules the schema can't say (a base type has a look or a kind, not both; which values go with which) are checked by the validator.

block.description: The default type of room blocks; must be static.

slot.description: Index in a block of save bits (D71).

spellSlot.description: Its bit in the save's spell block (D71), also the lit bit on its data disk; unique among spells.

spellColor.description: The spell's color: its disk's lit bit, its effect, its install animation and banner.

spellCost.description: Energy per cast, in whole units (the wizard holds 50); multiples of 10 read best, as the HUD bar has segments of 10.

spellCooldown.description: Seconds before he can cast again.

kind.description: disk: teaches a spell (permanent); refill: restores integrity or energy (temporary).

spell.description: The spell it installs (defs.json spells); its save bit is the spell's slot.

stat.description: What it restores (its look and color follow).

amount.description: How much, up to the wizard's maximum. A refill is left lying while that stat is full.

blockType.description: A base type has a look (a static block in the room grid) or a kind (each cell runs as a room object); a variant ("extends") only the values it changes.

extends.description: Variant: the base block type (one without "extends") whose values it takes; its own values replace the base's.

look.description: Static blocks: plain (dark faces, neon edges), hazard (red pixels switching on and off, flares when it hurts) or void (grains sinking inside a black block). Looks are built into the engine (src/render/block-fx.js).

kind.description: Blocks that change: each cell becomes a room object of this kind (src/entities/kinds.js). collapsing: shakes when the wizard stands on it, then vanishes (D47).

color.description: Edges (and lit pixels or grains). Plain blocks without a color take the room color. Required for a kind.

damage.description: Static blocks: integrity the wizard loses when he touches it (stands on it or walks into it).

lethal.description: Static blocks: landing on top kills the wizard and enemies instantly; touching a side is safe.

regrow.description: Collapsing blocks: seconds after vanishing until the block grows back (once its cell is clear). Without it the block stays gone until the room resets.

enemyType.description: A base type has every required value; a template ("extends") only the ones it changes.

extends.description: Template (D58): the base enemy type (one without "extends") whose values and look it takes; its own values replace the base's. Saved from the room editor.

look.description: Its body (src/render/entity-view.js ENEMY_MODELS). Any look combines with any movement and attack (D77). bug: a hopping ball; virus: a gliding sharp cube with orbiting bits; sentinel: a tall sharp octahedron with one eye.

movement.description: Movement behavior (src/ai/behaviors.js). patrol: walks its path (room data "path", required) cell by cell, turning back when blocked; stationary: stays in its cell (still falls and rides platforms); chase: goes after the wizard while it sees him within aggroRange (chaseSpeed), searches where it lost him for memory seconds, then goes back to its post, or walks its path if it has one. Enemies never step into a hole or onto a lethal block.

attack.description: How it hurts the wizard while hostile. touch: touching it; none: never. burst and arc are discharges (touching it doesn't hurt): when it sees him within attackRange it stops, charges for attackCharge seconds, fires lightning, then waits attackCooldown seconds. burst: lightning all round it, hitting the wizard and other enemies within attackRange; arc: one bolt, aimed where the wizard stood when it started charging, up to attackRange or the first block or object; it hits every body (the wizard, other enemies) in the squares it passes through.

hostility.description: hostile: attacks (red eyes); peaceful: never attacks (cyan eyes); provoked: peaceful (amber eyes) until a spell hits it, then hostile.

aggroRange.description: Units within which a hostile enemy notices the wizard, if nothing blocks its line of sight: a chaser goes after him, a burst or arc fires; a "!" pops up over it (any enemy). At least attackRange for a burst or arc.

chaseSpeed.description: Speed in units per second while it chases or searches (chase movement); its speed by default.

memory.description: Seconds a chaser searches where it last saw the wizard before it gives up.

attackRange.description: Burst or arc reach in units, from its middle to the nearest point of the wizard.

attackCharge.description: Seconds it charges (the warning) before a burst or arc fires.

attackCooldown.description: Seconds after a burst or arc before it can charge again.

attackColor.description: Lightning color of a burst or arc; its color by default.

integrity.description: Hits it takes to destroy (spells, from step 6).

damage.description: Integrity the wizard loses per attack.

speed.description: Walking speed in units per second (a path's own speed overrides it).

bounce.description: Trampoline top: landing on it bounces the wizard up (clearing 2 blocks) without hurting him; its sides still hurt if it is hostile.

solid.description: Solid: the wizard can not walk through it; he stands on it and rides along, and it shoves him when it walks into him (turning back if he is pinned). Touching it counts when he leans against it. Not solid: he walks through it.

color.description: Body (hologram) color; the eyes show hostility.

kind.description: Which engine behavior the object uses. pushable: the wizard pushes it; platform: follows its path (room data "path") carrying the wizard and pushables; target: a fixed block a Zap switches on and off; plate: a floor tile (y 0) that is on while a crate, an enemy or the wizard stands on it. Targets and plates are switches: the room's locked exits open while all of them are on (D75); their look is fixed (render/switch-view.js), only the color comes from here. Collapsing blocks are block types ("blocks", D60).

faces.description: dark: like static blocks; tinted: faces shaded in the object color (top lighter).

tint.description: With tinted faces: share of the object color in the top face; the sides get less.

integrity.description: Pushable objects only: makes it destructible, taking this much spell damage (Zap: 1 per hit) before it breaks into pixels. It is drawn with its data bits with some missing (a grid of small squares, holes in it) instead of its mark, so it reads as breakable next to a crate with the whole grid. Without it the object is indestructible.
